evidence_text: The Texas Historical Commission's atlas gives the official National Register boundary as "Roughly Bounded by Genesse, West Dallas, Arthur and W. Gray Sts."
notes: A street-bounded boundary description is not a coordinate. Converting it to a defensible polygon or centroid requires Harris County parcel or GIS data, which has not yet been consulted. Do not infer an arbitrary centroid from the boundary streets alone.
